title: A.X K2 Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2608.30181v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce A.X K2, a 688B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model trained from scratch as a high-performance foundation for \emph{agentic} applications. Trained on approximately 8.5T tokens---fewer than its predecessor, A.X K1---on a smaller but higher-quality mixture with substantially expanded agentic and software-engineering data, it nonetheless improves over A.X K1 across the board, by over 30 percentage points on some benchmarks, reflecting large gains in token efficiency. To support long contexts efficiently, we introduce Sparse Gated Attention (SGA), which combines sparse attention with gated attention, and adopt Gated Norm (GN) to stabilize large-scale training. SGA is trained natively at 128K through a \emph{sparse} indexer warmup that optimizes the indexer against its own sparse top-$k$ selection rather than the dense attention distribution, making adaptation markedly cheaper: each query reads only 2,048 positions,

translated_abstract: 我们介绍A.X K2，一个688B参数的混合专家语言模型，从零开始训练，作为智能体应用的高性能基础模型。该模型在大约8.5万亿个token上训练——比其前身A.X K1更少——使用了更小但质量更高的数据组合，并大幅扩充了智能体和软件工程相关数据，但它在所有方面都超越了A.X K1，在某些基准测试上提升超过30个百分点，体现了token效率的显著提升。为了高效支持长上下文，我们引入了稀疏门控注意力，它将稀疏注意力与门控注意力相结合，并采用门控归一化来稳定大规模训练。SGA通过一种稀疏索引器预热方法在128K上下文长度下原生训练，该方法针对索引器自身的稀疏top-k选择而非密集注意力分布进行优化，使适配成本显著降低：每个查询仅读取2,048个位置……
tldr: A.X K2是一个688B参数的混合专家语言模型，通过更少但更高质量的训练数据和创新的稀疏门控注意力机制，在智能体和软件工程任务上全面超越前代模型。
en_tdlr: A.X K2 is a 688B-parameter MoE language model that outperforms its predecessor across all benchmarks using fewer but higher-quality training tokens and a novel Sparse Gated Attention mechanism for efficient long-context agentic applications.
